__schema__: Per-campaign narrative + bug-to-fix lineage. Authored by AI NHI (Claude Opus 4.7). Each entry carries depth for three audiences: non-technical users, C-level decision makers, and subject-matter experts. Passing runs get the same analytical rigor as failing runs — a green badge without analysis is just a claim.

__audience_framing__.non_technical: Plain language analogies. What the run means for someone who relies on the software but doesn't read code. Focus on trust, reliability, what evidence backs what claim.
__audience_framing__.c_level: Risk, cost, compliance, audit, velocity. What business outcome does this run buy down or expose? What decision should leadership make based on it? What's the ROI framing?
__audience_framing__.sme: Specific invariants proven or violated, file paths, commits, methodology, the physics of why the test measured what it measured. No hand-waving; citations.
